description: Ministry of Labour - Wages Board for the Motor Transport Trade and Marine Transport and Operational Services Trade
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns regulatory matters under the Wages Boards Ordinance, specifically proposing variations to minimum wage decisions for the motor transport and marine transport trades. It involves statutory instruments, regulatory compliance requirements, and legal notifications about wage regulations, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service administration, judicial appointments, or other specialized categories that would take precedence.
